history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration re- examine the basis of the preparation of the cost plans to minimize the variation between the projected revenue and expenditure and to avoid any unreasonable overcharging of overhead.
history.administration_response: United Nations Office at Nairobi: In September 2024, the United Nations Office at Nairobi submitted to the Office of the Controller a revised cost plan for 2024, reflecting the revised estimates for the year based on the information available during the third quarter of 2024. The revised cost plan includes an explanation of the variance between the projected revenue and estimated expenditure for the year. At the end of 2024, the United Nations Office at Nairobi reviewed the indirect costs applied to the fund centres of its Division of Administrative Services and confirmed that the indirect costs charged to expenses (actual and consumed) did not exceed 7 per cent. Therefore, the United Nations Office at Nairobi requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that a revised cost plan for 2024 has been submitted to the Office of the Controller and that the indirect costs charged to expenses in 2024 did not exceed seven per cent, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
